title: Event Damage Checklist
subtitle: Capture affected property, pre-event condition, discovery time, and containment; confirm repair evidence and settlement.
description: Event Damage records affected property, pre-event condition, discovery time, containment, repair evidence, and settlement. Event Damage evidence stays linked.
use_case: Use this event damage stage-gated verification when staff must document affected property and pre-event condition. Reconcile discovery time, containment, repair evidence, and settlement before the event damage handoff. Use pre-event and post-event condition photos, inspection notes, vendor report, containment log, repair quote, invoice, insurance reference, settlement record, and venue acceptance. Ask the assigned event damage reviewer to confirm affected property against the organization's policy.

sections.title: Event Damage starting details
sections.guidance: Identify affected property, pre-event condition, discovery time, photographs, containment, vendor involvement, repair estimate, insurance route, settlement, and venue acceptance.

sections.title: Event Damage checks and corrections review
sections.guidance: Check current event damage facts at point of use.

blocks.label: Event Damage required checks
items: Affected property is identified for this record
Pre-event condition matches the current request or source
Discovery time is ready for point-of-use staff
Containment limits or questions are resolved
Repair evidence is communicated to the responsible person

blocks.label: Event Damage failed or pending items

sections.title: Event Damage readiness and handoff
sections.guidance: Hold event damage readiness on any failed or pending item.

blocks.label: Event Damage reviewer receipt
blocks.guidance: Event Damage receipt confirms the visible checklist result.
